recommendations.title: Consider the Opposite
recommendations.description: Deliberately argue the opposite of your current belief to expose blind spots.
action_steps: List 3 strong reasons it could be completely wrong.
Talk to someone who holds the opposite view.

recommendations.title: Pause and Reflect
recommendations.description: Slow down before deciding. Ask: What am I assuming? What am I ignoring?
action_steps: Ask a trusted person for their take.

recommendations.title: Seek Disconfirming Evidence
recommendations.description: Actively search for information that contradicts your current view.
action_steps: State what would prove you wrong.
Update your belief based on what you find.
